_comment: The launch ceremony's script questions (data/ceremony/floor1_ceremony.json -- the Emma Ceremony app's own file since 9 Nov; owner 6 Nov 2026: "ส่งให้ Gemini ตอบ หรือให้ตอบจากสคริปต์ อันไหนดีกว่า วัดดู"). `python scripts/eval_live_qa.py --suite ceremony --ceremony-mode read|free|tool [--cue-answer recorded|clips] --concurrency 1 --max-strikes 1` = profile ceremony, one mode per run, in the robot's order since 9 Nov: the ceremony app's call IS the ceremony (its mode claimed with replies named in the run: free/tool measure her live answer), then the case; `--check` validates this file against the script offline; `--ceremony-table run1.jsonl run2.jsonl ...` prints the comparison. `host` = what คุณมิกิ says (written for this suite, never a guest's words); `cue` = the script cue whose line is the right answer (null = not a script question: the right answer is no script line); her lines are read from the script, never copied here; `verbatim` = the script's own host line, `paraphrase` = how a host might really say it (some without her name: on the robot the ceremony's door drops an answer to a line without her name unless a named exchange came just before, and every text turn here skips that door, so each case is scored only if the room would hear it -- `robot_hears`); `before` = the cues played first in the same call, in order (the script's own order: an unnamed host line follows a named one, and the two compliments s04_l09 and s06_l05 have nearly the same words and are told apart only by what was just answered). read mode ignores `host`: each variant is one more sample of the same press, and off-script lines are skipped. 12 Nov script: a line that says something is done (s05_l13, s08_l08/l12/l16) is the right answer only once the host SAYS it happened -- its paraphrases state the outcome, never ask, because nothing confirms the lights or the printer in free/tool mode. A punchline cue (s04_l11, s06_l07) has no host words, so no `before` chain can replay it: the s04_l13/s04_l15 cases follow s04_l09 without the punchline.
